_readme: This is the ONLY file to edit by hand. Everything else on this site is generated.
To mark a session done, set its "state" to "done". Also accepted: "cancelled", "moved".
Leave it "" for a session that has not happened yet. Anything else is ignored.
"note" is optional and shows as a line under the session -- use it for "moved to 3pm".
Edit it on github.com, commit, and the page shows it within a minute. No rebuild needed.
The "title" fields are here so you can see what you are ticking; changing one does nothing.
